recommendations.title: Strengthen technical skills
recommendations.description: Technical skills are below the level expected for most placement roles.
suggested_steps: Pick one core technology for the target role and follow a guided course
Apply it in a small hands-on project

recommendations.title: Attendance improvement support
recommendations.description: Attendance is below the expected level in 2 subject(s). A short conversation to understand the reasons (health, travel, timetable, motivation) is the best first step.
suggested_steps: Meet the class mentor to identify which subjects are short and why
Agree on a realistic weekly attendance target
Ask faculty about make-up classes or notes for missed sessions

recommendations.title: Backlog preparation plan
recommendations.description: 1 backlog(s) recorded. Clearing them one at a time with a dated plan is usually more manageable than trying to do everything at once.
suggested_steps: Note the upcoming backlog exam dates
Clear the backlog with the best chance of passing first
Join tutoring or peer-study sessions for those subjects

recommendations.title: Assignment completion plan
recommendations.description: A good share of assignments is still pending. A small weekly routine can help catch up.
suggested_steps: List all pending assignments with their deadlines
Finish one pending assignment every two days, oldest first
Ask the faculty about extensions for assignments that are already overdue

recommendations.title: Resume improvement
recommendations.description: A clear, well-structured resume improves shortlisting chances.
suggested_steps: Get the resume reviewed by the placement team
Add measurable details to projects and internships
Keep it to one page with a consistent format

recommendations.title: Communication and soft-skills practice
recommendations.description: Communication and teamwork matter in interviews and on the job.
suggested_steps: Join a communication or group-discussion workshop
Practise a 2-minute self-introduction with a friend or mentor

recommendations.title: Increase regular learning time
recommendations.description: LMS activity or weekly learning hours are low. Short, regular study sessions work better than rare long ones.
suggested_steps: Set fixed study slots in the weekly timetable
Log in to the LMS at least every other day to check new material
Share a weekly learning-hours goal with the mentor
